title: Italian-Style Chewy Fritters
description: Crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, these Italian-style fritters are perfect as an appetizer or snack. Made with a mix of flour, eggs, and cheese, they're easy to make and always a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour and egg.
Add cheese and milk, mix until smooth.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 2-3 fritters to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
